title: Yellow Garlic Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A garlicky and romantic Spanish dish featuring chicken, full fat yogurt, and beurre-monte, cooked to perfection in a kazan cauldron.
instructions: Heat the beurre-monte in the kazan cauldron over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the saffron threads, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the full fat yogurt and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the cauldron from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
